_readme: Maps each canonical FPAI team name (as it appears in raw_matches.home_team/away_team,
i.e. what FeatureFactory.build_for_match expects) to football-data.org's real API
'name' and 'shortName' fields, so the W06 story can normalize football-data.org fixture
data before calling the agent/forecast engine.
'confidence' reflects how sure this mapping is:
verified - confirmed against a real, authenticated football-data.org API response
high     - standard 'X FC' pattern, unverified but very likely correct
medium   - plausible guess (e.g. whether 'City'/'Town'/'United' survives into shortName), unverified
low      - genuinely uncertain, unverified
Only Premier League teams (raw_matches league='E0') are covered, since that's the only
league with real feature-store data today (see app_user_stories.md Integration Gaps).
2026-07-11 verification pass: the 20 teams that played in the Premier League during the
2025/26 season (GET /v4/competitions/PL/teams?season=2025 -- this matches the season
raw_matches actually covers, since the API's default/current season had already rolled
over to 2026/27 by the time this was run) were checked against a live, authenticated call
and are now marked 'verified'. Teams not in that season's roster (Cardiff, Huddersfield,
Hull, Ipswich, Leicester, Luton, Middlesbrough, Norwich, Sheffield United, Southampton,
Stoke, Swansea, Watford, West Brom) were not needed for 2025/26 testing and remain
unverified guesses -- verify them if/when a season involving them becomes relevant.
Coventry City FC (new for 2026/27) has zero rows in raw_matches under any name across the
full 2016-2026 span and is intentionally excluded here -- see agent_user_stories.md US#108.
